message:
- **You push it**, Instructions: Settings (gear) → System → Backup manager → Create backup for cloud, ticking Include additional files to get attachments, avatars, and logos, then Download backup file when it finishes. Lands as one .zip on your disk (entities.xml + activeobjects.xml + attachment folders); admin-only, runs at most once per 24h and only keeps one backup at a time (48h between runs if attachments are included).
- **We pull it**, Instructions: from a site-admin account, go to [id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens](http://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens) → Create API token → label it → Create → Copy to clipboard (it's shown only once). Paste the token, the admin account's email address, and your site URL ([yourcompany.atlassian.net](http://yourcompany.atlassian.net)) into a one-time link at scrt.link and email us that link.

Let me know if you prefer to push this service or have us pull it!
notes: Cloud backups are admin-only, run at most once per 24h (48h when attachments are included), and only one backup is retained at a time.
Completion depends on the selected Jira site and admin export scope.
